item_verdicts.diff: read the single commit b97d4bdf47f51ad9074cfad15370fef377c52d13 across four files (+43/-2), all inside the declared scope: the single-member render branch at imas_codex/llm/search_formatters.py:242, the rank golden at tests/llm/test_search_tools.py:731, the new row test at tests/llm/test_signal_report_rows.py:62, and the node fragment.

item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, one commit b97d4bdf47f51ad9074cfad15370fef377c52d13, carrying baseline_suite and after_suite arms with revision/command/exit_status/completed/failure_count/failure_ids, negative_control_log logs/negative_control.log, and a landing line.

justifications.durability: tests/llm/test_signal_report_rows.py:68 reddens under the recorded control (logs/negative_control.log, EXIT=1) when the _interpolate_template call at imas_codex/llm/search_formatters.py:249 is removed, and the `0.92 not in result` assertion at tests/llm/test_search_tools.py:732 reddens on a re-added fused score.

justifications.fit: the new block at imas_codex/llm/search_formatters.py:242 carries a mechanism comment with no plan label or ticket, reuses the module's own helpers, and the fragment's element ids (ssfms-result-rows-tests-*) begin with the node id.
